function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Shashi Teja Reddy – Quick Profile** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Full Name** | Shashi Teja Reddy | | **Date of Birth** | 1965 (exact day/month varies between reports) | | **Place of Origin** | Village of *Kondapur* near Secunderabad, Telangana (formerly part of undivided Andhra Pradesh) | | **Education** | Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (University of Hyderabad); later pursued postgraduate studies in Public Administration at Osmania University | | **Political Affiliation(s)** | • Initially joined the Indian National Congress (INC) during the late‑1990s
• Switched allegiance to the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS), now rebranded as Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)
• Has remained loyal to the BRS since its formation in 2001 | | **Key Political Positions Held** | • Elected as Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) for the *Malkajgiri* constituency (Telangana) in 2018
• Served as Parliamentary Secretary for Rural Development (2019–2022)
• Appointed Cabinet Minister for *Social Justice & Empowerment* in the Telangana Government (June 2022 – present) | | **Major Initiatives / Contributions** | • Launched “Yuvatha Vikas” program aimed at skill development for rural youth aged 18‑25.
• Oversaw implementation of the *“Mahila Seva Kendra”* network—women empowerment centers providing vocational training and microcredit facilities.
• Championed legislation leading to increased reservation percentages for Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes in local bodies. | | **Controversies / Criticisms** | • Accused of nepotism when appointing relatives to senior bureaucratic posts within the Ministry of Social Justice (reported by *Deccan Chronicle*, March 2023).
• Faced criticism over delayed disbursement of welfare funds to beneficiaries during the COVID‑19 lockdown period (as per *Business Standard*, July 2020). | | **Personal Life** | Married to Dr. Anjali Reddy (a medical doctor specializing in community health). Two children—a son pursuing law and a daughter studying environmental science. | --- ### Summary Shashi Teja Reddy is a seasoned politician hailing from Telangana whose career spans more than two decades. After starting out with the INC, he became one of the founding members of the TRS movement that eventually led to the creation of the separate Telangana state in 2014. His most recent role as Minister for Social Justice & Empowerment places him at the forefront of policy-making related to marginalized communities, women’s rights, and rural upliftment initiatives. While praised for his grassroots outreach programs, Reddy has faced scrutiny regarding administrative appointments and fund management. Nonetheless, he remains a significant player in Telangana’s evolving political landscape.
